response.overview: Three roommates have been living together, better or worse, but on their own terms. They haven’t felt limited neither chained. They weren’t exactly happy but also not exactly bad. Suddenly, there comes COVID-19. Nothing seems to be how it was. Maciek and his two roommates lose their jobs momentarily. Their small obscure apartment becomes some sort of a prison, where emotional tension and frustration multiplies every day… There might come a catastrophe. Maciek finds a hole in his bedroom wall behind which hides a dystopian and  nostalgic reality - a sentimental asylum. Exploring his past and confronting tormenting emotions results in coming to an interesting conclusion. It turns out there are some diseases, especially those connected to the human psyche, for which there are none vaccines.
response.title: Stan podgorączkowy
